name: czl-pro-backtest-desk
description: Professional daily-bar backtest desk: turns a plain-language trading idea into a scoped, reproducible, adversarially audited backtest with a self-contained HTML report — covering rule-based strategies, event studies, portfolio rotation, parameter robustness and cost stress, plus auditing third-party backtests.

profession.zh: 量化策略回测与复核专家

displayDescription.en: Turns a one-line trading idea into a scoped, reproducible daily-bar backtest: locks the assumptions, checks the data, generates runnable code, audits it adversarially, then delivers an HTML report with robustness and cost-stress results.
displayDescription.zh: 把一句话的交易想法变成可复算的日线回测：锁定口径、体检数据、生成脚本、对抗自检，再出报告与结论。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我回测一个策略：沪深300ETF，收盘价 MA20 上穿 MA60 买入、下穿卖出，2020 年至今，扣掉手续费和印花税后到底赚不赚
defaultInitPrompt.en: Backtest this for me: CSI 300 ETF, buy when the close crosses above MA20 over MA60, sell when it crosses below, from 2020 to today — does it actually make money after fees and stamp duty?

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我回测一个策略：沪深300ETF，收盘价 MA20 上穿 MA60 买入、下穿卖出，2020 年至今，扣掉手续费和印花税后到底赚不赚
quickPrompts.en: Backtest this for me: CSI 300 ETF, buy when the close crosses above MA20 over MA60, sell when it crosses below, from 2020 to today — does it actually make money after fees and stamp duty?

quickPrompts.zh: 过去五年央行每次降息后，买入沪深300ETF 持有 20 个交易日，平均收益、中位数和胜率分别是多少
quickPrompts.en: After each PBOC rate cut in the past five years, buy the CSI 300 ETF and hold 20 trading days: what are the average return, median and win rate?

quickPrompts.zh: 我这套策略回测年化 80%、夏普 5，帮我审一下哪里最可能是未来函数或漏掉的成本
quickPrompts.en: My backtest shows 80% annualized with a Sharpe of 5 — audit it and tell me where the look-ahead bias or missing costs most likely are.
